You hold a Construction Yard (fact), an Ore Refinery (proc), a Power Plant (powr) and one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) on an ore patch, with $1000 in the bank. The Refinery alone caps stored ore at 2000. Within about 20 turns, reach economy value $6000 (cash plus stored ore) and keep the Construction Yard and Refinery standing.
